_help: Stakeholder preferences that define the utility function for the best-option check. Prices, terms and eligibility come from price_sheet.csv and policies.json; only the weights and the retention beliefs below are stakeholder inputs. Advisory: they never change the scored APPROVE/HOLD/BLOCK unless policy.json welfare_mode is 'enforce'.

objectives.customer_cost: Monthly cost to the customer (lower is better). From price_sheet.csv and the discounts in policies.json.
objectives.customer_flexibility: Refund window (longer is better) and commitment (shorter is better), equally weighted. From policies.json refunds and billing type.
objectives.company_revenue: Expected 12-month revenue = monthly price x 12 x the company's retention belief for that offer (higher is better).

retention_beliefs.why: Placeholder beliefs from the company stakeholder for an at-risk customer who says the price is too high [ASSUMPTION, not data]: annual billing is a 12-month contract; a discount makes staying more likely than the list price. Replace with the support lead's own estimates.

price_first_customer.label: Price-first customer
price_first_customer.why: A customer whose main complaint is price and who is happy to commit.

flexibility_first_customer.label: Flexibility-first customer
flexibility_first_customer.why: A customer who wants a lower price but won't lock in or give up the 30-day refund window.

balanced.label: Balanced: customer 50 / company 50
balanced.why: The support lead weighs the customer's outcome and the company's revenue equally.
